author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Crime The incident is among several reported cases of scammers exploiting pet owners searching for missing animals.
A Somerville woman whose cat went missing on Halloween is warning other pet owners to watch out for scammers who prey on people searching for lost animals.
Stacey Ota’s cat, Luna, disappeared on Halloween night, prompting Ota to put up missing-pet flyers around Somerville and post about her search on social media.
